any_day.why: the natural default without the chat: books any day of the week, Mondays included

no_gap.why: refuses only overlapping bookings, so one can start the minute the last one ends

under_10_days.why: off by one: refuses a booking exactly 10 days ahead, though on the 1st you can book the 11th

half_hour_gap.why: a look-alike value: half an hour between bookings instead of 26 minutes
